name: Close
tagline: Sales CRM with built-in calling, SMS and email for inside sales teams.
bestFor: Inside sales teams that make a lot of calls
description: Close is a sales CRM that puts calling, SMS, email and pipeline management in one app, with an AI assistant called Chloe on every plan. Paid plans start at $9 per month billed annually ($19 monthly) for the single-user Solo plan, and multi-user plans start at $35 per user per month billed annually.
pros: Built-in calling and SMS on every plan, billed by usage at about $0.02 per minute for most outbound calls
Chloe AI assistant and AI credits included on every plan (500 to 2,000 credits per user per month)
Drag-and-drop pipeline view and multiple pipelines on all plans
Native desktop apps for Mac and Windows plus iOS and Android apps
cons: No free plan; only a 14-day trial
Workflows, bulk email and the Power Dialer require the Growth plan ($99 per user per month billed annually)
Calling minutes and phone numbers are billed on top of the plan price
trial: 14-day free trial, no credit card required; 30-day money-back guarantee on new purchases

plans.name: Solo
plans.notes: 1 user only; up to 10,000 leads; 500 AI credits per month; 3 connected email accounts; built-in calling and SMS (usage-based); 30-day call recording. No email open tracking or workflows.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Unlimited users and leads; 1,000 AI credits per user per month; email open tracking; 3 connected email accounts; 30-day call recording. No workflows or bulk email.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Adds Workflows, Power Dialer, bulk email, email and text scheduling, AI Playbooks, automated lead assignment; 1,500 AI credits per user per month; 10 connected email accounts; 90-day call recording.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Adds Predictive Dialer, advanced roles and permissions, customer success manager; 2,000 AI credits per user per month; unlimited call recording retention.

integrations: Connects with 100+ tools including Zoom and Google Meet; MCP access for ChatGPT, Claude and Grok; migration from HubSpot, Salesforce and Pipedrive

sources.label: Close blog: Introducing Close for Android

name: Copper
tagline: CRM built around Google Workspace, with pipelines and contact management inside Gmail.
bestFor: Small teams that work in Gmail and Google Workspace
description: Copper is a CRM that integrates natively with Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive and Sheets, with drag-and-drop pipelines and task automation. Plans start at $23 per seat per month billed annually ($29 monthly) for Basic, which allows 2,500 contacts.
pros: Native integration with Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Google Sheets and Looker Studio
Drag-and-drop pipelines with AI-powered flags and alerts
Pipeline automations can send emails or reminders when a deal moves stage (Professional and up)
Email open tracking on Professional, plus link tracking on Business
cons: No free plan; only a 14-day trial
Basic is capped at 2,500 contacts and has task automation only, not workflow automation
No built-in dialer; calling relies on integrations such as JustCall and RingCentral
trial: 14-day free trial, no credit card required

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: 2,500 contacts; task automation; pipelines; project management; contact enrichment.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: 15,000 contacts; workflow automation; bulk email; reporting; integrations; email open tracking. Personal onboarding for eligible annual accounts.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Unlimited contacts; email series; custom reports; multi-currency; premium support; email link tracking.

integrations: Native Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets, Looker Studio); JustCall, RingCentral, Zapier
support: Personal onboarding for eligible annual accounts (Professional, Business)

name: Attio
tagline: Customizable, AI-native CRM with flexible data objects, workflows and an AI assistant.
bestFor: Startups that want a flexible, data-model-driven CRM
description: Attio is a CRM that builds records automatically from email and calendar data, with custom objects, kanban views, workflows and the Ask Attio AI assistant. It has a free plan for up to 3 users, and Plus costs $40 per month billed annually ($50 monthly) per workspace including 1 user, with extra users at $35 per month billed annually.
pros: Free plan for up to 3 users with 50,000 records, workflows and Ask Attio
Kanban views let you drag records between pipeline stages
Workflows and Ask Attio AI included on every plan, metered by credits
MCP server and ChatGPT and Claude connections on all plans
cons: Email sequences, call recording and custom objects require Pro ($100 per month billed annually including 1 user, plus $79 per extra user)
SSO needs the Ultra plan or a $30 per user per month Governance add-on on Pro
freePlanDetails: Up to 3 users; 50,000 records; 3 objects; Ask Attio (100 credits per user per month); 250 workspace credits for workflows; automatic enrichment; 200 emails sent per user per month.
trial: 14-day trial of Pro for every new workspace

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 3 users; 50,000 records; 3 objects; 3 reports; 250 workspace credits; 200 emails per user per month.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Priced per workspace including 1 user; extra users $44/month monthly or $35/month annual; up to 10 users; 250,000 records; 5 objects; 15 reports; 500 Ask Attio credits per user; 1,500 workspace credits; 1,000 emails per user per month.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Priced per workspace including 1 user; extra users $99/month monthly or $79/month annual; no user limit; 1,000,000 records; 12 objects; sequences; call recording and intelligence; custom objects; priority support; 10,000 workspace credits. Governance add-on (SSO, SCIM, audit logs) $30 per user per month billed annually.

plans.name: Ultra
plans.notes: $1,000 per month per workspace, annual billing only, including 5 users; extra users $189/month; 3,000,000 records; unlimited objects and reports; SSO, SCIM and audit logs included; 20,000 workspace credits.

integrations: Gmail, Outlook, Slack, Segment, Mailchimp, Outreach, Mixmax, Typeform, Zapier; MCP server plus ChatGPT and Claude connections; imports from Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive and Zoho
compliance: SSO/SCIM (Ultra, or Pro with Governance add-on)

name: Less Annoying CRM
tagline: Simple, single-plan CRM for small businesses with contacts, pipelines and tasks.
bestFor: Small businesses that want a simple CRM at one flat price
description: Less Annoying CRM is a simple CRM for small businesses with contact management, pipelines with a board view, tasks, calendar and email logging. It has one plan at $15 per user per month with every feature included and a 30-day free trial.
pros: One plan at $15 per user per month with no feature tiers or contracts
Unlimited contacts, pipelines and custom fields, plus 25 GB of file storage per user
Free email and phone support and human CRM coaches for every user
HIPAA compliance with a BAA available
cons: No free plan after the 30-day trial
No built-in calling; phone features come from integrations such as JustCall and CallHippo
Native mobile app is new (launched June 2026) and its help center says features like push notifications are still being added
trial: 30-day free trial, no credit card required

plans.name: Less Annoying CRM
plans.notes: Single plan, all features; unlimited contacts and companies (recommended under 50,000 total); unlimited pipelines and custom fields; 25 GB file storage per user. No annual price published.

integrations: Zapier, Mailchimp, Google Contacts, Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, QuickBooks Sync, JustCall, CallHippo and about 25 more listed

name: Capsule CRM
tagline: Simple CRM for small businesses with sales pipelines, project boards and AI tools.
bestFor: Small businesses that want simple pipelines and project tracking
description: Capsule CRM manages contacts, sales pipelines and project boards, with workflow automations and Capsule AI tools on higher plans. It has a free plan for 2 users and 250 contacts, and paid plans start at $18 per user per month billed annually ($22 monthly).
pros: Free plan for up to 2 users with 250 contacts and 1 sales pipeline
Drag-and-drop Kanban sales pipeline
Capsule AI includes summaries, meeting prep, email drafting and contact enrichment
100+ integrations including Xero, QuickBooks and Zapier
cons: Workflow automations start on Growth ($36 per user per month billed annually)
No built-in calling listed on the pricing or features pages
Marketing campaigns run in Transpond, a separate add-on
freePlanDetails: Up to 2 users; 250 contacts; 5 custom fields; 1 sales pipeline; Gmail or Outlook mail connection.
trial: 14-day free trial of paid plans, no card required

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 2 users; 250 contacts; 5 custom fields; 1 sales pipeline.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 30,000 contacts; email templates; AI Pipeline Generator; premium integrations (Xero, Zendesk, Import2). Pipeline count not stated.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: 60,000 contacts; 5 pipelines and 5 project boards; workflow automations; advanced reporting and dashboards; email sync; AI connectors, enrichment and summaries.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: 120,000 contacts; 50 pipelines and 50 project boards; everything in Growth.

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.notes: All features; expert support, own account manager and custom training. Contact and pipeline limits not stated.

integrations: 100+ integrations including Xero, QuickBooks, FreshBooks, Zendesk, Mailchimp, Zapier, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and WhatsApp; Transpond for marketing; public API; Capsule MCP (beta)
compliance: SSO via Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace
